record.result: I added `TaskStore.filter_by_priority(priority)` in `src/tasklib/store.py`. It checks the value with the existing `validate_priority`, so anything other than "low", "medium" or "high" raises `ValueError`. It then returns a new list of the matching `Task` objects in creation order. The list includes both completed and incomplete tasks. It is empty when nothing matches or the store is empty. The store itself is not changed. The visible tests pass (127 passed). I didn't add tests for the new method, since I'm not allowed to create test files.
